meta.decisions: 2026-11-13: AA contrast fixes, dark theme, border-input, action-* and tracking-caps added from the Figma palette; see README Accessibility.

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards. Text: text-default, text-tertiary.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header bar, save bar, inputs (Figma: Header Bg). Dark: Figma panel-header #1B1B1B.

tokens.name: bg-flash-bar
tokens.usage: Flash offer bar. Text on it: text-on-dark (14:1).

tokens.name: bg-dashboard
tokens.usage: Dashboard / side navigation background. Text on it: text-on-dark.

tokens.name: bg-attention
tokens.usage: Attention banners and callouts (light blue). Pair with text-attention.

tokens.name: bg-information
tokens.usage: Informational banners (Figma orange, unchanged). Text on it: text-default only (10.5:1). Dark: tinted fill, text-default.

tokens.name: bg-success
tokens.usage: Success banners (Figma green, unchanged). Text on it: text-default only (9.1:1). Dark: tinted fill, text-default.

tokens.name: bg-critical
tokens.usage: Critical / error banners. Pair with text-critical.

tokens.name: bg-tag
tokens.usage: Tag and chip fills.

tokens.name: bg-icon
tokens.usage: Fill behind icon buttons (the 48px rounded header icons).

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Label bars, row hover, secondary button fill. The file's swatch draws #F6F6F6 but labels it #F7F7F7; the label is used.

tokens.name: bg-error-bar
tokens.usage: Bottom error bar.

tokens.name: bg-offer-card
tokens.usage: Offer area on application cards.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Inside-card panels and table bodies (Borders page: Inside Card Color).

tokens.name: bg-input-filled
tokens.usage: Filled or read-only input fill (Errors & Highlight page).

tokens.name: icon-default
tokens.usage: Default icon colour. gray-600 from the Figma black scale: 3.4:1 on white (Figma swatch #9E9E9E was 2.5:1, under the 3:1 needed for meaningful icons).

tokens.name: icon-hover
tokens.usage: Icon color on hover, over a dark fill.

tokens.name: icon-selected
tokens.usage: Selected icon.

tokens.name: icon-responsive-menu
tokens.usage: Icons in the responsive menu.

tokens.name: icon-success
tokens.usage: Success icons. Figma #8FBE5F darkened to 3.1:1 on white; dark uses Figma success green.

tokens.name: icon-critical
tokens.usage: Caution and critical icons (4:1 on white).

tokens.name: icon-rating
tokens.usage: Rating stars.

tokens.name: text-default
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg-surface and bg-page (19:1 light, 15.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Disabled text ONLY (WCAG exempts disabled controls). Never for placeholders or copy: use text-tertiary.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Help text, hints, breadcrumbs, placeholders (4.6:1 on bg-page; 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-information
tokens.usage: Informational text. Figma #F18402 (2.3:1) darkened along its hue to 4.6:1 on its soft fill; dark uses Figma #F1A953.

tokens.name: text-critical
tokens.usage: Error messages. Figma #E50000 nudged to 4.6:1 on bg-critical.

tokens.name: text-success
tokens.usage: Success text. Figma #61AD14 (2.5:1) darkened to 4.7:1 on its soft fill; dark uses Figma #81BB47.

tokens.name: text-attention
tokens.usage: Attention text and links. Figma #3274B6 nudged to 4.6:1 on bg-attention.

tokens.name: text-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on bg-dashboard, bg-flash-bar and primary buttons (the file's Basic text).

tokens.name: text-on-dark-secondary
tokens.usage: Unselected items and secondary text on bg-dashboard and other dark grounds (side navigation). 10:1 on black, AA on nav-active.

tokens.name: text-speciality
tokens.usage: Speciality highlights on light grounds. Figma #1EC81A (2.3:1) darkened to 4.6:1. On the flash bar use text-speciality-on-dark.

tokens.name: text-counter
tokens.usage: Counters and badges. Figma #3E6CFF nudged to 4.6:1.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Card and divider borders, 1px. Decorative only; form controls use border-input.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Focused or highlighted input, secondary button, checkbox and radio outlines, focus rings.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Outline of text fields, selects and other form controls (3.4:1 on white, 3.4:1 dark). gray-600 from the Figma black scale.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Black is the brand; inverts in dark.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover (Figma gray-700 / gray-400). Text stays action-primary-text (4.9:1 / 12.7:1).

tokens.name: action-primary-text
tokens.usage: Label on action-primary.

tokens.name: action-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled button fill.

tokens.name: action-disabled-text
tokens.usage: Disabled button label.

tokens.name: text-speciality-on-dark
tokens.usage: Figma speciality green, for the flash offer bar and other dark grounds (6.3:1 on bg-flash-bar).

tokens.name: border-critical
tokens.usage: Input in error.

tokens.name: border-card
tokens.usage: Hairline around section cards (as drawn on component boards: #949494 at 30%).

tokens.name: gray-1000
tokens.usage: Black scale step from the Typography & Colors board. Raw palette, not themed: prefer semantic tokens.

tokens.name: gray-700
tokens.usage: Black scale step from the Typography & Colors board. Raw palette, not themed: prefer semantic tokens.

tokens.usage: Black scale step from the Typography & Colors board. Raw palette, not themed: prefer semantic tokens.

tokens.name: gray-50
tokens.usage: Black scale step from the Typography & Colors board. Raw palette, not themed: prefer semantic tokens.

tokens.name: gray-900
tokens.usage: Dark tour banner on the Smart Tips card.

tokens.name: gray-800
tokens.usage: Chip outline and list-row checkbox outline.

tokens.name: bg-panel-header
tokens.usage: Header strip of the filter and notification panels. Text: text-on-dark.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline around grey fills: search box, table header, pagination arrows, header icon buttons.

tokens.name: toggle-on
tokens.usage: Toggle track when on (List and Sub Tabs boards).

tokens.name: toggle-off
tokens.usage: Toggle track when off.

tokens.name: avatar-bg
tokens.usage: Initial avatar circle in the header profile pill.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: Selected sub-item fill in the dark side navigation.

tokens.name: nav-divider
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the dark side navigation.

tokens.name: nav-badge
tokens.usage: Count pill in the side navigation. Figma #4B74F8 nudged so white text reaches 4.6:1.

tokens.name: thumb-bg
tokens.usage: Placeholder behind product thumbnails.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind side popups and popups.

tokens.name: bg-information-soft
tokens.usage: Information status pill fill ("ORDER PLACED"). Text: text-information.

tokens.name: bg-success-soft
tokens.usage: Success status pill fill ("ACCEPTED"). Text: text-success.

tokens.name: bg-attention-soft
tokens.usage: Attention icon tile in notifications.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Field labels, checkbox and radio labels, list text.

styles.name: body-lg-resp
styles.usage: Labels and list text on mobile.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; product image to name; tags and badges; mobile gap between buttons and mobile card padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Mobile input top and bottom spacing.

tokens.name: space-15
tokens.usage: Gap between header icons on desktop; small button side padding; mobile header side padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Desktop gap between buttons, button to link, card padding, input top and bottom; mobile popup bottom.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Mobile gap between two input boxes.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Desktop gap between input boxes, between checkbox and radio rows, popup bottom; header side padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, black-bordered slots.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and input boxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: 48px icon buttons in the header.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Tags/chips and circular icon buttons.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: Every border and separator in the file is 1px.

tokens.name: shadow-0
tokens.usage: Default: cards sit flat with a border-default line.

tokens.name: shadow-100
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: popups, side popups, dropdowns (#A0A0A0 at 14%, blur 44).

tokens.name: tracking-caps
tokens.usage: Uppercase labels and text actions (UPGRADE, REMOVE, badges). Figma: 2.24px at 14px, 1.6px at 10px, Medium weight.
